name: Instruction Cancellation Request Status 21 Choice
definition: Choice between different instruction cancellation request statuses.

CancellationCompleted.name: Cancellation Completed
CancellationCompleted.definition: Provides status information related to an instruction cancellation request completed.

Accepted.name: Accepted
Accepted.definition: Provides status information related to a cancellation request accepted for further processing.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Provides status information related to a cancellation request rejected for further processing due to system (data) reasons.

PendingCancellation.name: Pending Cancellation
PendingCancellation.definition: Provides status information related to a pending cancellation request.

ProprietaryStatus.name: Proprietary Status
ProprietaryStatus.definition: Proprietary status related to an instruction cancellation request.
